name: Jones County, GA
findings: Jones County has 45 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jones County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
